The NFD6, also known as a Nova Corps “pa: The NFD6, also known as a Nova Corps “passkey,” is a personal data device provided to the higher ranks of Nova Corps. This one, registered as P4933403-5, was reported defective and discarded by Centurion Meggmek. Its core operating software has since been modified to block access to the Xandarian Worldmind and to override specific door locks throughout Hala’s Hope. Important rules and regulations primers have been deleted and replaced with forbidden entertainment software and Xandarian “zap-pop” music.
My fifth investigation into our grand “Q:
My fifth investigation into our grand “Quarantine Zone” ebrium-based nano-resin cluster-foam experiment is complete, and I can report that my material is performing as expected, if a little slow. The various debris here, mostly consisting of wrecked vessels, has begun to compress and bind together within the protective sphere. The soft materials aboard these ships have been significantly dissolved and many of the harder metals are showing significant structural weakness. Before long, they should begin to start collapsing, their pieces pulled together and bound by the nano-resin. Again, I recommend that if Nova Corps insists on patrolling the sphere, they do it externally. It is not safe.

We also need to discuss long-term disposal once the sphere is sealed permanently. Even though its contents will be rendered unusable, some of the more hazardous materials within will not be rendered inert. For this reason, I am against the proposal to push it into a star. We don’t know what kind of reaction that might cause. Instead, I propose we launch it into Knowhere’s Rift, where it should theoretically cease to exist.
The war rages between Resistance forces:
The war rages between Resistance forces and the vile Chitauri. We’ve engaged them throughout the Seknarf system with the costliest battles taking place in orbit of Seknarf Nine. We’ve already seen the Chitauri landing on the planet’s surface, which makes us rethink our belief that it is a neutral world. Or maybe the Monster Queen fights her own resistance below?

If we ever intended to find an alliance here, we’ve long since ruined our chances by pelting her world with downed ships. Not just Chitauri--we’ve already lost half of our own fleet. It must look like the heavens are raining fire from down there. There are no winners in this conflict. Only death. We’re waiting for the inevitable retreat orders. We cannot win this battle. I’m not even certain we can win this war.
Madam,\nI have no doubt in the veracity:
Madam,
I have no doubt in the veracity of your claim. I also believe the skull in question to belong to a long-extinct offshoot of the Ghilaron species. An untrained eye could see that from nothing but the mandible. In fact, I am quite sure that if we could bring but just a sample of the skull into the laboratory, for verification, or rather security in the righteousness of our knowledge, we could prove this formidable beast once roamed the known galaxy.

What a discovery that would be!

I beg you to reconsider. All I would require is the smallest chip of bone, and you, my fair Lady, would be held amongst the greatest of all naturalists of the universe.

I have the honour to be, Madam, Your Majesty's humble and obedient servant,
Yarrt’Ol, Chief Zoologist
Egghead Reviews: That’s More Like It: Egghead Reviews: That’s More Like It
His real name unknown, “Lipless” is a no:
His real name unknown, “Lipless” is a notorious Rydoctylan smuggler with an ever-growing list of arrest warrants. Nova Corps once targeted him on Mah Lillia, but he somehow eluded their flophouse raids. Recently he’s shifted his focus towards trafficking in rare animal bones and illustrious hides. Lipless sells to everyone from renowned artists to galactic royalty, all under the table, of course.

Rumor has it that the master smuggler has secured lucrative deals with the Collector himself, which greatly increases the risk involved. It would account for his recent dealings with the Headmen interstellar poaching operation.

Rydoctylans are known for their mercurial temperament, caused by the rapid evolutionary process on Rydoctyla. Predators and prey can swap roles within a couple hundred cycles, leading to very malleable brain development. Lipless is no exception. He murders friends as fast as he makes them and is best avoided.
To all authorized Nova Corps personnel. 

Please do not use two-hundred-thousand-unit suits to roast Choga dogs, perform stunts in zero-G, or for target practice. 

THEY ARE NOT TOYS!
Lip, baby, I’m pleased to see our number:
Lip, baby, I’m pleased to see our numbers trending up. And to think you thought you were finished after that business on Mah Lillia. Didn’t I tell you there was more money in exotic materials than you’d ever make in your dingy flophouse? 

Won’t be long before every Elder in the galaxy is askin’ for their pound of flesh. And we’ll be the ones to provide it.  

Keep it up and that moon will be ours in no time. 

I’m counting on you. 

Yours, 
Rubes
Perhaps \"Blades of Ichor\" is a more ap: Perhaps "Blades of Ichor" is a more appropriate descriptor since this divine weapon can be divided or reconfigured into multiple lethal instruments due to its divine liquid-metal core. Before I was able to procure them, they were wielded by an angel from Heven. Or was she an Asgardian? Queen of Hel? One thing is clear: Aldrif Odinsdottir, Angela for short, used the Blades of Ichor to sever countless limbs from sinners and heathens across the galaxy. She would not hesitate to claim my own limbs, should she and her weapons be reunited.
This oversized orb is the plucked eye of: This oversized orb is the plucked eye of a Watcher, one of the universe's oldest and most powerful races. Their decision to intervene on behalf of less advanced worlds once resulted in great catastrophe, so they have taken a permanent vow not to meddle in our affairs. Apparently, somebody meddled in theirs, presumably to harness the Watcher's incomprehensible powers. It is safe for now in my collection, content to return your curious gaze. Does it see you back, I wonder?
Everything about this chair and the man: Everything about this chair and the man who sat in it is soaked in temporal anomaly. Don't worry, I've had it thoroughly cleaned. Constructed by a scientist from the far future, this magnificent device allowed him to build a violent legacy stretching backwards, and forwards, across time. Calling himself Kang the Conqueror, his timestream manipulation united thousands of alternate Kangs, who created warring Councils of Kang. I was able to procure this device after two Kangs killed one another. Finders keepers.
A rare Centaurian weapon added to my col: A rare Centaurian weapon added to my collection with the arrest of the Ravager pirate lord, Yondu Udonta. These deadly arrows can be propelled and directed to tear through enemy forces with specific whistle pitches from its wielder. Their opponents now know to "aim for the mouth" or face swift destruction from these nasty little things. It is unknown whether races outside of the Centauri can command such a device, but feel free to whistle at it and see what happens. I assure you, all are safe within these walls.
Many of my visitors pass right by this s: Many of my visitors pass right by this simple document, but you have a keen eye. It is actually a prophecy transcribed in trance by the frothing monks of Seknarf Five. One should take it as a warning since their prophecies are rarely wrong. This one speaks of a world where those gifted with powers fight amongst themselves, divided in a bloody civil war that will risk the destruction of everything they swore to protect. You may wish such a thing does not come to pass, but its value will increase exponentially if it does. I will cheer for this civil war.
Master crafted by the Dwarves of Nidavel: Master crafted by the Dwarves of Nidavellir, this Odin-blessed sword was gifted to his gatekeeper, Heimdall. Any god-wielded weapon is a centerpiece in one's collection, but Hofund possesses numerous magical talents, including the ability to open the rainbow Bifrost Bridge to any of the Nine Realms. A shame it's not in mint condition, but if you look closely, you may be able to spot the hate-filled bloodstains of Mangog on its broken blade.
If you see a relic before you, you're in: If you see a relic before you, you're in luck! Occasionally, a pair of lenses manifest, eyewear that belongs to a powerful cosmic entity seemingly capable of being anywhere in the galaxy at any given time. He has appeared throughout history in multiple worlds and I suspect he will continue to do so throughout the future as well. Though we do not know his motives, many believe this mysterious being has had a profound impact on our galaxy. Excelsior!
This one hurts. I used to be in possessi: This one hurts. I used to be in possession of the galaxy's last Flora Colossi, the sole survivor of Planet X's destruction. The enormous plant creature called itself Groot. Often. During its escape, I was able to sever and retain a small piece of its wooden body. You may see a simple sprout. I see the potential to regrow my lost prize, though he will be far less precious with the original running loose.
You see before you the deadliest of spec: You see before you the deadliest of specimens taken from Broodworld, an infant queen embryo extracted from her unfortunate host. Within that armored skull lies a fully-developed, predatory brain, eager to conquer us all and use our bodies as breeding grounds for her parasitic spawn. I assure you she is heavily sedated and quite harmless now, but please do not tap on the glass.
Il Libro di Cagliostro. Rolls right off: Il Libro di Cagliostro. Rolls right off the tongue, but beware not to speak the forbidden words within lest you summon extraplanar fiends. This legendary spell book is a trove of miraculous magic, unspeakable curses, and unthinkable peril. Mine is more than just a copy, spawned directly from the original in some weird self-preservation ritual. You could say that I safeguard the backup copy, should the original ever tear a hole in reality itself and wink out of existence.
What if you could wish for anything? Thi: What if you could wish for anything? This Cosmic Cube would bend reality itself to make it so. It is perhaps the most important part of my collection as I have used it to secure each of my artifacts in protective pocket realities. You may look, but you have no hope of ever touching. I will not wish more from it because it whispers to me with the voices of past owners, including one of a particularly infernal temperament. I am content to admire from afar.
Ten potent weapons, one for each finger,: Ten potent weapons, one for each finger, crafted from gems that once belonged to a mighty Makluan dragon race. It is said that each contains the soul of a legendary warrior and each has a unique power. The real fun comes in combinations: darkness and extreme cold or fire and blinding light. Perhaps a lightning-filled vortex. Disintegrate a foe while controlling their mind. Blow them up and then put them back together. The Mandarin was not eager to part with these rings, but my hired help was able to take them off his hands.
The tiara of Narya, a mystical shape-cha: The tiara of Narya, a mystical shape-changer conceived to battle the Great Beasts menacing her homelands. Rebranded as Snowbird, Narya fought alongside a team of superpowered Terrans named Alpha Flight. However, as a spiritual protector of her territory, she was unable to leave its borders. That is, without the device you see before you. I'm told its components were built from the very soil of "Canada," which allows her to carry her home with her. Regrettably, she has not shown up to claim it, so it remains a part of my collection.
It's easy to underestimate the raw power: It's easy to underestimate the raw power of this relic due to its miniscule size. Frogjolnir is said to be an unintentional gift from the Asgardian God of Thunder, or rather his goat, whose errant hoof-strike chipped off a tiny piece of Thor's own hammer. Although I'd rather have the full-sized Mjolnir in my collection, Frogjolnir did grant its bearer powers identical to Thor himself. It is also ridiculously adorable. Even with Hyde's Formula, I cannot lift it.
Burning with the intensity of a solar fl: Burning with the intensity of a solar flare at each end, this artifact channels the Power Cosmic and was originally wielded by a hotheaded herald of Galactus. Its former owner, Firelord, once scouted the galaxy for the World-Devourer's next meal. At some point, they must have had a falling out because I was able to procure this gorgeous implement of destruction for the low price of an entire planet. I would have gone as high as three.
Richard Rider. Leader of the Galactic Wa: Richard Rider. Leader of the Galactic War Resistance and hero to countless races. The man so embodies Nova Corps that he rebuilt it from its ashes and chose Nova as his own moniker. Typically, I do not associate with law enforcement, but this relic was donated by Rider himself, just prior to his disappearance. You see before you his original helmet, which has a direct connection to the Xandarian Worldmind. Rider claimed he upgraded to a new helmet with its own Nova Force reactor to make the Worldmind "shut up." I think he enjoyed the idea of them "blabbing away in some stupid museum." Delightful.
Truly a strange fruit, plucked from the: Truly a strange fruit, plucked from the Tree of Shadows in Null Space. The Shi'ar Fraternity of Raptors used these mysterious amulets to swap their biological bodies for cybernetic ones. With these sleek battle suits, the Raptors were gifted with rapid interstellar travel, extreme strength, resilience, regeneration, and destructive energy blasts. I am told it will also tune you in to the Datasong, a type of shared consciousness. I do not like to share, so the amulet remains safely on display.
You might think this is the God of Thund: You might think this is the God of Thunder transformed into a frog. It is actually a frog transformed into the God of Thunder. One of several Gods of Thunder, to be precise. This tiny fellow packs quite a punch, matched only by his thunderous croak. Captured after decimating an entire Badoon fleet with one throw of his mighty hammer, Frogjolnir, I selflessly bailed him out of prison and found him a permanent home here in my collection. If he tells you otherwise, do not listen. Asgardians are known for their devilish pranks.
Oh, yes. The most destructive weapon in: Oh, yes. The most destructive weapon in the entire universe and I have it. On loan. From Galactus. In the hands of an immensely powerful being with an exceptional mind, like Galactus, the Nullifier could detonate entire solar systems, even timelines. Perhaps even reality itself. I have been entrusted with its temporary safekeeping, though I hope the World-Devourer will forget he left it with me. If I were to ever attempt to use it, he would instantly summon it back to himself. So feel free to admire the potential end of life as we know it while it is still in my possession.
Occasionally, the Terran mind is capable: Occasionally, the Terran mind is capable of exceptional brilliance. Take Calvin Zabo, for example. Through chemistry, Zabo believed he could push the human body beyond its accepted limits and created this potent serum. Upon imbibement, his musculature rapidly expanded, enabling his brutish alter ego, "Mr. Hyde," to hold his own against some of Earth's greatest champions. Zabo now wastes away in a Terran prison, but I wasn't going to let his serum go to waste as well.
We are sending this message to every Nov:
We are sending this message to every Nova Corps helmet, terminal, and personal device to ensure every Corpsman is informed. Please do your part to spread the message. The recent events on Hala’s Hope and The Rock station have led us to quarantine both vessels. Contact with those recently stationed at either is strictly forbidden. Do not accept their communications, distress beacons, or direct pleas for help until we have properly assessed the situation.

We believe a psychological attack has been launched upon Nova Corps, but we do not yet understand the delivery method. It is not clear if it can be spread person-to-person, but we do know it spreads rapidly. For the time being, we need to isolate ourselves to prevent further infection.

Inquisitor #04684 has been temporarily disabled due to a malfunction between the terminal and its battery.

Loyal reader! This is why I come to Know:
Loyal reader! This is why I come to Knowhere to drink!

As I scribe for you, a cacophony of clamorous explosions, chased by indignant claxons, screams away. I take a sip of otherwise unremarkable Mercurian scorcher and right now it tastes like ambrosia. A crowd just dashed past, arms flapping and mouths spouting hysterics about invasion. Just another day on the edge of oblivion and I FINALLY feel relaxed.

Here, every problem is somebody else’s as long as you’ve got your lips to a glass. You can take yourself right out of the game and enjoy the fact that—at least this time--it’s not you. So thank you, my endangered unfortunates, for your sacrifice. I raise a glass to whatever ails you!

This cycle’s death reports are similar to the last and we urge supervisors to invest in better filtration pumps and personal protective gear. Workers can be easily replaced, but the reputation of the guild cannot. Incidents follow:

Shoomy-Gorath is an adorable stuffed tri: Shoomy-Gorath is an adorable stuffed tribute to everybody’s favorite Many-Angled One, minus all the angles. Squeeze him, throw him, or hang him in your windshield, Shoomy’s got his eye on you. What’s he planning?
This ticket grants entry to the extravag: This ticket grants entry to the extravagant Collector’s Emporium, which promises “a Collection of Curated Curios and Cultural Curiosities from across the Cosmos.” It permits standard viewing access for one rotation. Guests are encouraged to sign up for a yearly membership, which includes unlimited access, two refreshments, and access to the interdimensional abomination petting zoo.
A showcase for some of the most powerful:
A showcase for some of the most powerful weapons, artifacts, and beings in the galaxy, the Emporium is the personal collection of Taneleer Tivan, aka, the Collector. Tivan claims he is an Elder of the Universe, dutybound to preserve and protect items too dangerous, or too unique, to be allowed their freedom. His right to do so is often the subject of violent discussion.

The Collector’s Emporium is currently stationed in Knowhere, where visitors can pay a modest ticket price to view his prized possessions. The collection poses no risk to Knowhere itself, as the pieces are not physically present in our reality, not since the theft of his precious Groot from Planet X.
Gnasher and Gasher are two sibling rhydu:
Gnasher and Gasher are two sibling rhydurms who have become Lady Hellbender’s most beloved pets. Rumor has it she paid more than twice the value of her own palace for the two beasts. She personally raised them from pups and the three now share an almost telepathic link. She can simply give them a look and they will immediately jump to her protection. Lady Hellbender often rides the larger rhydurm, Gnasher.

Rhydurms are voracious predators and it’s rare to find two anywhere near each other in the wild. A single rhydurm is responsible for the natural culling of entire animal populations. While their fangs and claws are deadly, their tails are like wrecking balls—deceptively heavy with tails muscled enough to wield them. A rhydurm can pulverize the chest of a much bigger animal with a single blow. Gnasher and Gasher have been trained so well, they only occasionally smash down the palace walls.
